summary: SOL Strategies filed a Form 6-K reporting it settled approximately C$5.75 million of debt by selling 65,001 SOL tokens at an average price of C$87.88 per SOL. This is an ordinary-course treasury management action, not a special situation. The company reduced balance sheet leverage to focus on its operating business, including Houdini Swap. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situations event. The filing is a routine report of debt reduction through asset sales.
